nativeRegistration: Do not upload a file to Agent Assets or call it a native skill without product registration, loading indicator and actual run proof.
mechanicalCheckBoundary: Exact citation/quote/scope checks do not establish semantic entailment, clinical adequacy or authenticated authority. Record independent/human review and promotion separately.
permissionBoundary: Only retrieve user-selected scope with the current authenticated principal. Stop each denied read; do not reuse stale cached content, expose denied metadata or switch identities/clients to evade denial.
searchBoundary: Search hit is discovery only. Retrieve exact file/version before citation. Missing result is not absence; use existing archive index. Unsupported/scanned content stays unknown without qualified extraction.
unsupportedFormats: PDF/Office/scanned/.captured sources require a separately qualified authenticated extraction; never claim archive-wide text coverage.
runtimeBoundary: Deployed assistant must run entirely in M365 and Power Platform. Codex is development/testing only and cannot satisfy native runtime acceptance.

cliLookup.hashBoundary: sha256 is UTF-8 extracted text; binarySHA256 is original native file bytes

powerAutomateReader.qualification: source-and-fictional-tests-only; native owner retains actual run receipts separately
powerAutomateReader.deploymentState: generated-stopped; actual native state requires readback
powerAutomateReader.originalStudioDraft: preserve unchanged; no conversion or billing change
